title: Anthropic Is Paying $85,000 to Learn AI
description:
Want to break into AI?

Anthropic's Claude Corps is a paid program designed for early-career professionals to gain hands-on AI experience while working with nonprofits.

Here's what the program includes:

• $85,000 annual salary
• Weekly AI training
• Mentorship from CodePath and Anthropic
• Real-world projects with nonprofit organizations
• No college degree requirement mentioned for participation

If you're looking to build practical AI experience and work on meaningful projects, this is an opportunity worth exploring.

Check the pinned comment for the application link and my tips for standing out.

#ai #anthropic #claude #careers #artificialintelligence #tech #jobs #aitools #career #machinelearning
